scripts.bundle: tauri build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const src=path.join('src-tauri','target','release','bundle');const dst='installers';fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const sub of ['nsis','msi']){const dir=path.join(src,sub);if(fs.existsSync(dir)){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)){if(f.endsWith('.exe')||f.endsWith('.msi')){fs.copyFileSync(path.join(dir,f),path.join(dst,f));console.log('Copied installer to '+dst+'/'+f);}}}}"
